conversion: percent SpellMod factors multiplied as binary32 per term in canonical exact-effect order
note: Trinity GetSpellModValues accumulates float pct *= pow(...) (Player.cpp ~22800-22840) but iterates class-mask pct mods before label pct mods in m_spellMods order; Core orders by exact effect. Order only matters for >=3 non-exact factors.
Trinity std::pow(1.0f + CalculatePct(1.0f, value), float(applyCount)); exact for count 1; libm ulp agreement for count>=2 is UNK-B-003.

conversion: PercentFirstEffect factor computed in f64 1+p/100 then narrowed to binary32 at aggregation
cooldown (base + flat) * binary32 factor, truncated once, clamp <=0 to suppression
note: Trinity ApplySpellMod<int32>: T((double(base)+flat)*float pct) (Player.cpp ApplySpellMod) then negative -> 0 (SpellHistory.cpp:491-496).

conversion: ordinary cooldown duration = trunc(base / haste / rate_speed).max(1)
witness: base 66000 ms, one +10% raw-286 rate: Core trunc(66000/1.1)=59999; Trinity floor(66000*(100/110))=60000 (SpellHistory.cpp:431-445). Same shape for base 110000/+10% (99999 vs 100000). Division by f64 speed vs multiplication by reciprocal.

conversion: charge duration (base+flat) * f64 prod(1+p/100) / haste / speed, truncated once
note: Trinity GetChargeRecoveryTime uses float multipliers and floor (SpellHistory.cpp:975-1010).

conversion: op-15 excess 1+(M-1)F in f64 with binary32 F
note: Trinity applies op 15 to an int32 crit_bonus (Unit.cpp:7296-7317) truncating the scaled excess to an integer; Core keeps fractional amounts.
